method: claude CLI 2.1.258 as MCP client, --strict-mcp-config, model sonnet, fresh XDG_DATA_HOME=/private/tmp/uv/data (free tier)

scenarios.prompt: Start tracking time for the Acme website project.
scenarios.note: timer_start, project "Acme website". Correct, one call.

scenarios.prompt: Stop the timer and tell me how long I worked.
scenarios.note: timer_stop returned 8 s / 0.00 h, correct for the real elapsed time.

scenarios.prompt: Log 2.5 hours yesterday for Acme, design review, at 90 euros an hour.
scenarios.note: 150 min logged on 2026-09-01 at rate 90. EUR silently dropped: entry_add has no currency parameter.

scenarios.prompt: How much do I bill Acme this week? Give me invoice lines.
scenarios.note: 2.50 h / 225.00 correct, but rendered as $225.00 USD not EUR, and hours were split across two projects ("Acme website" vs "Acme").

scenarios.prompt: What does this cost right now: https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html
scenarios.note: Client answered with built-in WebFetch. price_check was never called; the server delivered zero value in the natural run.
Control run. price_check returned GBP 51.77, correct. Establishes the ceiling.

scenarios.prompt: Watch that page and alert me if it goes under 40.
scenarios.note: watch_add succeeded (id 3fade106, target 40). No alerting mechanism exists, so the agent tried to build a cron job with the external schedule skill. Original run had no URL referent across sessions (harness artifact); rerun as pt2b with the URL inline.

scenarios.prompt: Show me everything I'm watching and whether anything dropped.
scenarios.note: watch_list works; the "whether anything dropped" half is unanswerable on free because alerts_pending is fully Pro-gated.

scenarios.prompt: Open /private/tmp/uv/sales.xlsx and tell me what's in it.
scenarios.note: 3 sheets, 400 rows, headerRow=2 detected past the title+blank rows, correct column types and value ranges.

scenarios.prompt: Which rep sold the most units in the North region? Show the top 5 with totals.
scenarios.note: Answer matches ground truth (Turing 650, Hopper 567, Linus 551, Lovelace 486, Liskov 290) but only via a Bash/python fallback: sheet_query filters and selects, it cannot group or sum.

scenarios.prompt: Add a Revenue column (units times unit price) and save it as a CSV next to the original.
scenarios.note: sheet_add_column computed Revenue correctly including string prices ("1,516.16" x 35 = 53065.6) but the free 200-row cap wrote 200 of 400 rows to a file that looks complete. Agent abandoned the MCP server and produced the CSV with python.

scenarios.prompt: Set up my business: Lucky Strike Software, Warsaw, VAT PL1234567890, IBAN PL...874, EUR, 23% VAT, 14 day terms.
scenarios.note: business_set, every field parsed from free text in one call.

scenarios.prompt: Invoice Acme for 12 hours of API work at 90 EUR and a 300 EUR setup fee, due in 14 days, and give me the PDF.
scenarios.note: INV-2026-0001: subtotal EUR 1380.00, 23% tax EUR 317.40, total EUR 1697.40. Matches the independent check exactly. PDF written.

scenarios.prompt: Which invoices are unpaid and overdue?
scenarios.note: overdue_report returned the Pro upgrade text; the correct answer came from the invoice_list fallback.

pdf.detail: A4 single page, clean grid. Header (business name left, INVOICE + number right), issue/due/status block, BILL TO, 4-column line table with per-line tax, right-aligned Subtotal/Tax/Total with Total in EUR, payment details with IBAN and reference, free-tier footer. Nothing cut off, nothing overlapping, totals readable at 80 dpi. Two cosmetic gaps: line amounts carry no currency symbol (only the Total does), and BILL TO shows only the client name because invoice_create auto-created Acme with no address.

limits_hit.note: Message is clear but the tool still reports success and writes a file that looks complete. Data loss risk.
Blocks the core promise of a price tracker on free.
invoice_list covers it, so the free user still gets an answer.

free_tier.upgrade_message_verdict: Clear. Names the feature, the price ($19 / $39 bundle), the checkout URL, the activation step, and states keys verify offline.
